note: 'Tell Aaron, Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt' (Exod 7:19), and again over the frogs at 8:5. **The first several are Aaron's hand, not Moses's.**
'I will multiply My signs and wonders in the land of Egypt' (Exod 7:3), and 'I will execute judgment against all the gods of Egypt' (12:12).
held: inside quoted speech (the Berean's quotation marks), speaker not on record

note: 'I will bring upon Pharaoh and Egypt one more plague. After that, he will allow you to leave this place.' (Exod 11:1).
'I will send all My plagues against you and your officials and your people' (Exod 9:14). **The plagues are announced before they are sent**, each with a demand attached.
'Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded ... Aaron raised the staff and struck the water of the Nile' (Exod 7:20). **Announced by Moses and worked through the rod in his hand.**

'So Moses thought, I must go over and see this marvelous sight. Why is the bush not burning up?' (Exod 3:3). **The turning aside is the act the chapter turns on** -- the voice comes only after it (3:4).

'Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron by night and said, Get up, leave my people' (Exod 12:31). **The release comes the night of the last plague and not before**, the Egyptians urged the people on to send them out in haste (12:33).
